text:
maria: quick q — if a customer's Dedicated pool hits sustained pressure, can we still allow automatic spillover to Hosted while keeping their isolation guarantees? thinking about data egress and model variant mismatches.
sam: short answer: yes but only with strict transforms + telemetry. hosted may run different quantization and opt kernels. risk: subtle output diffs and potential PII leakage if we don't scrub context.
aj: idea: introduce a 'ttl-backpressure' window + compatibility shim that tags requests with a compatibility score. fallback pipeline would either route to same-variant hosted instance or run a redact/strip step.
aj: example routing pseudo-config:
```
route {
  prefer: dedicated
  on_capacity_pressure: {
    fallback: hosted
    transform: redact_sensitive
    variant_selector: compatibility_score >= 0.8 ? same_variant : default_safe
  }
}
```
katie: telemetry must show this. at minimum: tenant.evictions, fallback.count, fallback.latency_delta, variant_mismatch_rate, and a per-tenant "isolation_score" that feeds the console. need dashboard + alert if fallback.latency_delta > 200ms for 5m.
sam: quota interaction is tricky — hosted quotas differ per tier. propose token-bucket sync and a header `X-Priority-TTL` so clients can opt into short-lived spillover vs full failover. also: rate-limit downgrade policy so we don't saturate hosted.
maria: redaction could change model outputs a lot. we need prompt-set evals (prod vs redacted) to measure quality regression. also think about an opt-out for customers that explicitly allow hosted fallback without transforms.
aj: console/rollout UX: add a simulation toggle that shows predicted spillover probability for a selected tenant (based on recent qps + pool headroom). also expose a canary flag per-tenant `allow_hosted_fallback`.
katie: logging note — transforms must be reversible-free for PII, and logs should mark when a request was transformed. retention policy: scrub transformed payloads after 7 days by default.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: routing-shim-v1 -> staging (by aj)
sam: action items:
- aj: prototype compatibility scorer + routing shim (staging) — due EOW
- katie: dashboard tiles + alert thresholds — due Tue
- maria: assemble prompt-sets for high-volume tenants to run redaction evals — due Fri
- ops: document quota downgrade semantics for hosted spillover
maria: thanks — want to demo the simulation in tomorrow sync. :thumbsup:
katie: :eyes: will review telemetry schema tonight.
